# About us
  * [Home](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/en "Home")
  * About us


**BAREDES S.A.** is an Argentine representation company dedicated to the importation of quality raw materials for the Oil and Gas, Abrasives, Ceramics, Refractories, Oil Treatment, Friction, Sand and Surface Treatment Industries.  
It is the mission of the company to provide solutions and services to our clients. Objective for which we work with our best effort.
We are representatives of the **Curimbaba Group** in Argentina since 1963, marketing the products of its main companies: Mineraçao Curimbaba and Elfusa Geral de Eletrofusao Ltda.
We market and distribute products from other international companies such as Silicon Carbides from Saint Gobain in Brazil and Arenas Naturales from Incusa (Quartz Industries S.A.)  from Spain.
We have a large and permanent _**[stock](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/logistics/ "Image Gallery")**_ of merchandise which allows us to provide satisfactorily to our clients.
[![](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/logo_gcurimbaba_.jpg)](http://www.grupocurimbaba.com.br/es/home)
[![](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/logo_mcurimbaba_.jpg)](http://www.curimbaba.com.br/es/empresa/historia)
[![](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/logo_elfusa_.jpg)](http://www.elfusa.com.br/es/home)
[![](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/logo_sintex_.jpg)](http://sintexminerals.com/es/home)
[![](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/logo_incusa_.jpg)](http://www.incusa.es/index.php/es/)
From the close commercial relationship between **BAREDES S.A.** and the **Curimbaba Group** , Arquimia S.A. was born, an industry dedicated to the production of Aluminum Sulfate for more than 30 years.
[![](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/logo_arquimiasa_.jpg)](http://www.arquimiasa.com.ar/)
We have warehouses strategically located according to the route and final disposition of the imported products. For this we have warehouses in: Industrial Park Zarate (PLIZ), Industrial Park Pilar and Pilarica in the Province of Buenos Aires and in the Ferrosur Roca railway terminal in Colonia Valentina, Province of Neuquén.

### Aplicaciones
De nuestros productos:
La bauxita es la materia prima esencial para la producción de una serie de productos especiales utilizados por las industrias de Oil & Gas, Petroquímica, Tratamiento de Superficies, Cerámicas, Refractarios, Fundición, Tratamientos de Aceites y Agroquímicos.  
El óxido de aluminio electrofundido, en sus diversas variantes, es el producto esencial para la fabricación de abrasivos, cerámicas, refractarios y utilizado también para arenados y tratamientos de superficie.
![](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/produtos.png)
**Fractura de pozos de petróleo y gas**
![](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aplicacao1_.jpg)
Agentes de sósten cerámicos y arenas naturales para fracturas hidráulicas en pozos de petróleo y gas.
**Abrasivos**
![](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aplicacao4_.jpg)
Óxidos de aluminio y carburos para fabricación de discos de corte, piedras, ruedas abrasivas, lijas y puntas montadas.
**Cerámicas y refractarios**
![](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aplicacao6_.jpg)
Óxidos de aluminio, carburos y cementos aluminosos para cerámicas y refractarios.
**Tratamiento de superficies  
**
![](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aplicacao3_.jpg)
Granos esféricos y angulares de bauxita sinterizada y óxidos de aluminio usados en arenados y blasting.
**Tratamiento de aceites  
**
![](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aplicacao2_.jpg)
La bauxita activada es usada como absorbente para tratamiento de aceites, aislantes, comestibles, biodiesel, parafinas y querosene de aviación.
**Fundición  
**
![](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aplicacao5_.jpg)
Arcilla sinterizada y arenas especiales a base de bauxita sinterizada para fundición de hierro, aluminio y acero.

### Applications
Of our products:
Bauxite is the essential raw material for the production of a series of special products used by the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Surface Treatment, Ceramics, Refractories, Foundry, Oil Treatment and Agrochemical industries.  
Electrofused aluminum oxide, in its various variants, is the essential product for the manufacture of abrasives, ceramics, refractories and is also used for sandblasting and surface treatments.
![](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/produtos.png)
**Oil and gas fracking**
![](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aplicacao1_.jpg)
Ceramic proppants and natural sands for hydraulic fractures in oil and gas wells.
**A brasives**
![](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aplicacao4_.jpg)
Aluminum oxides and carbides for the manufacture of cutting discs, stones, abrasive wheels, sandpaper and mounted tips.
**Ceramics and refractories**
![](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aplicacao6_.jpg)
Aluminum oxides, carbides and aluminous cements for ceramics and refractories.
**Surface treatment**
![](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aplicacao3_.jpg)
Spherical and angular grains of sintered bauxite and aluminum oxides used in sandblasting and blasting.
**Oil treatment**
![](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aplicacao2_.jpg)
Activated bauxite is used as an absorbent for the treatment of oils, insulators, foodstuffs, biodiesel, paraffins and aviation kerosene.
**Foundry**
![](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aplicacao5_.jpg)
Sintered clay and special sands based on sintered bauxite for foundry of iron, aluminum and steel.

**Baredes S.A.** represents, distributes and markets in Argentina the products of recognized quality from the companies of the Curimbaba Group, a world leader in the manufacture of electro-molten oxides for the abrasive, ceramic and refractory industries. This group brings decades of experience and intensive research in the development of advanced technology for the production of proppants and electro-fused oxides. Our I + D and QC engineers continually improve the quality of existing products, developing solutions for the dynamic requirements of the Oil & Gas, Abrasives, Ceramics and Refractories industries. Mineraçao Curimbaba’s proppants and Elfusa’s aluminum oxides are its main products and are marketed worldwide.
The engineering and development of ceramic proppants has impacted the oil industry with continual improvements and solutions to address a wide range of well conditions. The SinterBlast, developed to address tortuosity, and the SinterLite Lock, developed for flowback control, are unique, patented products developed to meet the specific needs of Operators and Service Companies. The innovative I + D department works on projects and processes to achieve greater efficiency and optimal results in hydraulic fractures.
Mineraçao Curimbaba’s technical team has wide experience in the development and application of proppants. Each professional is dedicated to providing advice to ensure that the selected product meets the application requirements based on the parameters of the well. This experience, combined with the interaction with the professionals of Operators and Service Companies, generate invaluable data for the I + D Department on changing market conditions and technological advances. This information allows them to develop and offer the right product for completion operations, subsequently achieving higher production from the wells.

**BAREDES S.A.** is an Argentine representation company dedicated to the importation of quality raw materials for the Oil and Gas, Abrasives, Ceramics, Refractories, Oil Treatment, Friction, Sand and Surface Treatment Industries.  
It is the mission of the company to provide solutions and services to our clients. Objective for which we work with our best effort.
We are representatives of the **Curimbaba Group** in Argentina since 1963, marketing the products of its main companies: Mineraçao Curimbaba and Elfusa Geral de Eletrofusao Ltda.
We market and distribute products from other international companies such as Silicon Carbides from Saint Gobain in Brazil and Arenas Naturales from Incusa (Quartz Industries S.A.)  from Spain.
We have a large and permanent _**[stock](http://baredessa.com.ar/web/logistics/ "Image Gallery")**_ of merchandise which allows us to provide satisfactorily to our clients.

From the close commercial relationship between **BAREDES S.A.** and the **Curimbaba Group** , Arquimia S.A. was born, an industry dedicated to the production of Aluminum Sulfate for more than 30 years.
